purpose: Restore the evidence trust boundary by accepting card-ID authenticity only from sealed, source-bound metadata.
requirements: Remove candidate.authenticated_offer_id and every candidate-controlled path from authenticity decisions. Candidate data may state claims only, never attest a source ID.

Authenticate only through sealed metadata/manifest bytes loaded from the same leaf. Bind authenticated ID to leaf identifier, raw source SHA-256, DOM selector and exact card byte range; require all bindings to match the selected card.

Reject mappings whose metadata hash is absent from receipt inputs, whose source SHA differs, whose DOM selector/range differs, or whose ID is only schema-valid. Fail closed with distinct reason codes.

Add mandatory negative tests: caller-injected authenticated_offer_id with empty mapping; forged metadata mapping with SHA mismatch; ID mapped to a different byte range/card; valid schema but missing sealed mapping. Every case must HELD.

Keep R3-R6 broad-shell, directed-locality and validity protections. Positive control must derive its authenticity only from a sealed fixture metadata mapping that is hashed and listed as a test input.

Default verify-existing must remain non-mutating and compare all output/sidecar digests. Evaluate only sealed R3 vault bytes; preserve 0 VERIFIED / 10 HELD and perform no hydrate/package/deploy/scheduler/alias/rollback mutation.
acceptance_gate: CEO verify-existing replay and trust-boundary review required; no automatic promotion
